title: Account security
subtitle: Manage two-factor authentication, re-authentication, and signed-in devices.
twoFactorSubtitle: Optional for most accounts. Organization roles may require it; Admin Solo is mandatory later.
totpSecretHint: Add this secret in your authenticator, then enter a code.
recoveryCodesHint: Shown once. Store them offline — never in browser storage.
sessionsSubtitle: Revoke devices you do not recognize. Sensitive actions need re-authentication.
reauthSubtitle: Enter your password to continue this sensitive action.
offline: You are offline. Security changes require a connection.
invalidCode: That code is incorrect or expired.
capabilityDenied: You cannot manage security settings right now.
validation.passwordMin: Password must be at least 8 characters.
